Animated path plays Release, begins50ms movement, updates bounds, and registers its focus/selection helper on transition completion; direct path updates bounds and calls it now. That helper chooses Snap/Acquire, sends gain_focus, stores selectedRegion and sends SpawnRegionFocus only for the written lobby mode or simulatedCT. Requests target lose_focus then DefaultClip, clears selectedRegion and hides cursor only when the keep-visible argument is falsy. Gets the stick vector, negates y in that same table and stores it on the receiver. Collects beacons whose native hit-test contains the cursor, computes squared center distance, sorts by ascending distance with its owned comparator, and returns first marker or nil.
